thread:
jess_finance: Heads up - Redwood invoiced ZenithHealth for Private deployment renewal and platform fee appears doubled on INV-90211. Can someone check contract and billing rule?

noah_sales: I have the renewal packet. Theres an amendment AMND-4477 but Schedule C that should list the platform rate is blank in the signed PDF.

anya_custsuccess: Customer says they never agreed to a flat fee and expected the legacy 8% platform fee during the 90-day onboarding credit window. They sent screenshots of the invoice.

revenue-bot: Invoice INV-90211 lines: ["Commit: $150,000", "Platform fee: $24,000", "Support (Enterprise): $6,000"], total_due: $180,000. Applied rule: flat USD 16,000/mo x 1.5 billing factor = $24,000 (derived from Schedule C missing value).

jess_finance: If Schedule C is blank, we must default to Master Agreement percent. Master SOW platform fee = 8% -> expected $12,000.

noah_sales: Customer is agreeable to revert to 8% for this cycle if we issue a credit and wait to re-execute Schedule C correctly. They'll sign a corrected amendment.

jess_finance: Action: put INV-90211 on hold, create credit for $12,000, route credit > $10k to director approval, notify customer. I'll create CM-4410 provisional.

revenue-bot: CM-4410 created (provisional) for $12,000. Collection status set to On Hold - Billing Dispute.

anya_custsuccess: Customer confirmed they see the hold and appreciate the quick response. Will sign the corrected Schedule C this week.

jess_finance: Routing credit for approval now. Will update thread when final.
